notes:
# Blackline 0.15.138

* Notes and nicknames read in the app's own font at the chat's size (a text box takes the browser's font unless it is told otherwise).
* Threads: your own comments can be edited and deleted from the thread itself, the reply box has an emoji button, and nothing in a thread is reacted to.
* A message being edited shows no hover tools over it; the box carries its own emoji button.
* A pinned message shows the pin, not the word.
* A picture waiting to be sent shows a pointing cursor, not a magnifier.
* Names sit a shade larger than the words under them.
* Calling somebody who is not reachable no longer draws their card or says you are in a call with them: nothing was dialled and nothing rang, so the conversation says it will ring when they are back.
* "See who people are" says what is actually true: in a sealed space it is the keys, and in a space that does not seal every member already holds every member's record.
